summary: Iter 84 — Frontend-only UI tests for (a) Super Admin OpenAPI credito + storico, (b) Listino OpenAPI, (c) Anagrafica searchable 'Aggiungi relazione'. ALL FLOWS WORKING. (1) /admin-login with superadmin@assicura.it/superadmin123! authenticates and lands on /super-admin. sa-listino-openapi-btn opens sa-listino-dialog showing 7 editable price inputs (camerale, catasto, catasto_pdf, veicoli, visura, visure, report) with sa-listino-salva button present. (2) On Axicura Cattolica row (id 31b4950e-85c2-4232-a31f-ba226b7923fe), sa-credito-btn opens sa-credito-dialog. Initial cell shows 'non attivo', storico shows 'Nessuna ricarica / Nessun consumo'. Set 100 → toast 'Credito aggiornato: € 100.00', storico row '+100.00€ imposta · superadmin@assicura.it' appears. Add 50 → toast 'Credito aggiornato: € 150.00', storico shows both entries (+50 ricarica + +100 imposta) and header 'Ricaricato: €150.00 · Consumato: €0.00'. After page reload, table cell sa-credito-{id} correctly shows '€ 150.00' in emerald (persistence confirmed). (3) Agency login admin@assicura.it/Admin123! on /login OK. Anagrafica /anagrafiche/6df29f83-509a-4aa4-a176-5a033b49e4e9 → tab-albero 'Relazione' opens. add-relation-button opens dialog; rel-target-search is an INPUT (not <Select>), placeholder 'Digita nome, CF o P.IVA...'. Typing 'a' shows rel-target-list with 50 rel-opt-* results. Selecting first option replaces input with rel-target-selected chip ('+39 ITALIA S. R. L. ✕'); rel-target-clear button restores the search input. add-azienda-lr-button also present alongside add-relation-button. No blocking bugs. Backend endpoints observed: GET /api/super-admin/agenzie, POST openapi-credito, GET openapi-storico all return 200 after first save (initial 404 on openapi-storico before any record is expected — likely returns 404 when no doc yet; backend logic already validated by main agent).

minor.issue: Returns 404 when no credito record has been created yet (dialog then shows empty state correctly, but produces console error). Consider returning 200 with empty {ricariche:[],consumi:[]} for cleaner UX.

integration_issues.issue: Parent agenzie table cell 'sa-credito-{id}' does not refresh until page reload. Toast + storico update correctly, and value persists (verified on reload). Minor UX nit — consider calling fetchAgenzie() after successful POST openapi-credito.

action_items: (Minor) After sa-credito-salva, refresh agenzie list so the 'Credito API' cell updates without page reload.
(Minor) Backend: return 200 with empty arrays for openapi-storico when no record exists (avoid console 404).
critical_code_review_comments: SuperAdminPanel.jsx credito dialog: after POST openapi-credito success, only storico is re-fetched; parent agenzie list state is not refreshed. Add onSaved callback that triggers fetchAgenzie() to keep table in sync.
2 pre-auth 401 console errors on first render still present (already noted iter 81/82/83) — gate startup API calls on auth token presence.

Two entries persist in the openapi_credito_storico collection under super admin. If needed, main agent can reset via sa-credito dialog 'Imposta (saldo esatto)' with 0.

Anagrafica: tab-albero, add-relation-button, add-azienda-lr-button, rel-target-search (input, not Select), rel-target-list, rel-opt-{id}, rel-target-selected, rel-target-clear. Axicura Cattolica now has €150.00 credito for future consumption tests.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs. Only 1 minor UX suggestion (parent table cell not refreshed after credito save; persists after reload).
